## Overview

Starshipit is an ANZ-built **shipping-automation / fulfilment aggregator** that connects e-commerce platforms and inventory systems to multiple carriers for label printing, tracking, and returns. It is the recommended **carrier/shipping layer** for the Cycle Motion uplift under either Path, keeping commodity carrier integration off the critical-build path (buy-not-build) and in a loosely-coupled, replaceable layer.

## Products & Services

- **Shipping automation** — multi-carrier label generation, tracking, branded notifications, returns.
- **Platform integrations** — Shopify, Magento / Magento 2, MYOB, Cin7, DEAR, Unleashed, Datapel, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Xero, Amazon, eBay and more.
- **Carrier integrations** — Australia Post, Aramex, Sendle, DHL Express/eCommerce, Toll, Toll IPEC, Hunter Express, plus NZ and international couriers.

## Pricing Model

Tiered by monthly shipment volume (AUD): Starter from A$45 (0–100), Starter Plus A$125 (101–500), Professional A$180 (501–1,000), Professional Plus A$270 (1,001–5,000), Enterprise Plus A$500 (5,001–10,000), contact for >10,000. Indicative 3-year cost at the Starter Plus tier: ~A$4,500–5,000 plus modest setup.

## Strengths

- Connects to all three candidate cores (Datapel, Cin7, Unleashed) and to Shopify/Magento/MYOB — works under either Path.
- Deep Australian carrier coverage (Australia Post, Aramex, Sendle, Toll).
- Loosely coupled, replaceable shipping layer; commodity capability bought not built.
- Transparent volume-based AUD pricing.

## Weaknesses

- Adds another SaaS subscription and integration to operate and monitor.
- Carrier-account setup and rate configuration effort to confirm.
- Not an inventory/source-of-truth solution — complementary only.
